question: Which Indian Cabinet Minister was appointed as Executive Board Chairman of World Health Organization (WHO) in May 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harsh Vardhan.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian Cabinet Minister **Harsh Vardhan** was appointed as Executive Board Chairman of the World Health Organization (WHO) in May 2020.
 
• Dr. Harsh Vardhan is currently serving as** Minister of Science and Technology, Minister of Health and Family Welfare and Minister of Earth Sciences.**
 
• He is the Member of Parliament from Chandni Chowk, Delhi constituency.
 
• Dr Harsh Vardhan is an ENT Surgeon by profession.
 
• Dr Harsh Vardhan has been **elected** to the office of Chairperson of Executive Board of the World Health Organization from May 22, 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Piyush Goyal:**

 
 
• Piyush Goyal is the minister of Railways as well as the minister of the** Ministry of Commerce and Industry.**
 
• The Ministry of commerce and industry is a nodal ministry under the government of India which overlooks and regulates the working of trade and industry and is responsible for the growth and development of industry and trade within and outside the country.
 
• Piyush Goyal is the current minister of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• Piyush Goyal also handles the portfolio of the** Ministry of Railways.**
 
 
 
• ​**Nirmala Sitaraman:**
 
 
• She is the current Minister of Finance.
 
 
 
• **Smriti Irani:**
 
 
• **Smt. Smriti Irani, the Union Minister of Textiles** launched the India Size project in Mumbai on 6th February 2019.
 
• It aims to arrive at standard Indian size for the ready-to-wear clothing industry.
 
• A size chart will be developed which will be specific to Indian consumers measurements.
 
• The project is undertaken by the Ministry of Textiles.
